title: Saving a canonical shortcut disables the Wayland shortcut on restart
user: Save Ctrl+Alt+Space in Settings or through Tools; restart Box on Wayland/Hyprland.
expected: The saved shortcut remains registered and opens the Island.
actual: Startup sends canonical Ctrl+Alt+Space straight to the XDG validator, which rejects mixed-case modifier names. Owner log and isolated real nested Sway both show state=invalid_trigger.

title: Unit symbols lose case, producing billion-fold power errors and eight-fold data errors
user: Unit Converter: enter 1 mW to W or 1 MB to Mb, then Convert units.
expected: 0.001 W; 8 Mb. SI milli and mega, and byte and bit, are distinct.
actual: Successful results: 1 mW = 1000000 W; 1 MB = 1 Mb. Reproduced using packaged release CLI and actual GUI.
repro: python3 bin/isolate.py vu -- /home/harneet/.cache/arcade-audit/releases/Arcade-box/parent/squashfs-root/usr/bin/arcade-box run arcade.convert.units "1 mW to W" --json

title: The inch abbreviation is removed as an English connector
actual: Errors asking for source and destination units; spelling inch works. Source explicitly defines in as inch but first strips every in token.

title: Compound quantities and common energy prefixes are missing
user: Convert 5 ft 11 in to cm, 5 ft 11 inch to cm, or 1 MJ to kJ.
actual: Unknown unit 11 for the compound forms; Unknown unit MJ for energy. The parser reads only one amount and two unit tokens; the fixed unit table omits MJ.

title: The calculator cannot call its implemented log10 function
actual: Unknown constant log. The lexer stops identifiers before digits, so the implemented log10 branch is unreachable from normal input.

title: Formatted converter results change the number or show a nonzero result as zero
user: Convert 1000000.5 m to m or 0.000000001 m to km.
actual: Headlines say 1000000.5 m = 1000001 m and 0.000000001 m = 0 km, despite raw JSON values being correct. No approximate marker is present.

title: Tools CI no longer publishes the artifact consumed by nightly fleet checks
user: Maintainer relies on the green scheduled ecosystem matrix to validate released Tools install/adoption/self-update.
expected: The matrix can fetch the current main Tools AppImage and exercise every Tools lifecycle check.
actual: Latest green Link run 40469636881 says no unexpired tools-installer-ubuntu-* artifact in the latest five successful Tools main runs. Two Tools hub checks are SKIP, and eight development install checks are SKIP. Tools ci.yml builds and smoke-tests installers but does not upload an installer artifact (only overlay evidence).
release: Tools v0.3.8/main; Link current main 8a19346; this is a coverage defect, not proof a released installer fails
